title: Linus Resource Pack
description: Add Linus The Dog to your Minecraft world.
body: Add the Linus the dog! Linus the dog is sort of an inside joke with my friend group, but we like to share him around! How Linus came to be as an inside joke was when i originally made a website called [linus.games](https://linus.games/). (its still up!) And it featured this funny looking dog in every game, and since then we've been adding him to every game that we knew how to mod, and i guess its Minecrafts turn. So thats why THIS exists now.
